cohort_specificity: Upregulated in clonal JAK2 V617F+/CALR+/MPL+ PMF megakaryocytes (persistent on Type I JAKi); transiently elevated in AIMF prior to steroid/rituximab clearance

cohort_specificity: Clonal PMF & post-PV/ET MF megakaryocyte hyperplasia vs lower non-clustered expression in AIMF

cohort_specificity: Clonal PMF & post-ET/PV MF fibrotic marrow niche

therapeutic_or_diagnostic_relevance: Drives clonal expansion of LepR+ perivascular stromal progenitors prior to myofibroblast commitment; key CellChat ligand-receptor edge in single-cell antifibrotic screens

cohort_specificity: Advanced WHO MF-2/MF-3 cross-linked collagen PMF vs early uncrosslinked reticulin in resolving AIMF

cohort_specificity: JAK2 V617F+/CALR+/MPL+ clonal MF & Type I JAKi-persistent CD34+ cells

cohort_specificity: JAK2 V617F+ erythroid/megakaryocytic clones & ruxolitinib-persistent progenitors

cohort_specificity: Type I JAK2-persistent & RAS/MAPK co-mutated MF clones

cohort_specificity: Clonal PMF proliferation, BET/BRD4 super-enhancer addiction, & blast-phase progression

cohort_specificity: Clonal PMF & Triple-Negative PMF (~5-10%); absent in AIMF

cohort_specificity: Autoimmune Myelofibrosis, SLE marrow cytopenias, & VEXAS autoinflammation

cohort_specificity: Elevated across clonal JAK2 V617F+ MF (conferring selective fitness over normal WT HSCs), AIMF, & VEXAS
